info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Wholesale Trading Trading Book Oversights-spec
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Oversight API provides access to comprehensive oversight data for wholesale trading activities. This endpoint allows users to retrieve essential information on trading book oversights, which is crucial for compliance and risk management. Typical consumers include compliance officers and risk managers who need to monitor trading activities and ensure adherence to regulatory standards. The ability to access these insights aids organizations in making informed decisions and maintaining operational integrity.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch details related to trading book oversight within the wholesale trading system. It provides essential insights into trading activities and compliance.
